# Navigato

> MIT travel-booking React library (`@navigato/react`). Index only — not a teacher. Query DESIGN.md and the component registry in the GitHub repo before any prop. Never emit `@/components/ui` from memory.

`@navigato/react@0.2.0` is unpublished. Booking parts are `preview`, not `stable`. Changelog lives at the repo root.

## System

- [Getting started](/leo-design-system/getting-started/): consume from the repo; package is not on npm yet
- [Accessibility](/leo-design-system/getting-started/accessibility/): what consumers must still do
- [Tokens — color](/leo-design-system/tokens/colors/)
- [Tokens — type](/leo-design-system/tokens/typography/)
- [Gallery](/leo-design-system/components/pages/gallery/)
- DESIGN.md, AGENTS.md, and CHANGELOG.md live at the repo root. They are not HTML pages.
